candidate_reports.remark: Delayed report. Public report to NWS Little Rock social media and then relayed to our office. Time estimated from radar.
Reports of trees down in residential areas in Kingston_ including some on houses. Time estimated by radar.
Report of either a power pole or power line downed due to wind on G Street NW in Miami. Time estimated from radar.
Strong thunderstorm wind uprooted several trees_ snapped large tree limbs_ and damaged the roofs of a couple homes.
Delayed report. Video of hail with a max size of a quarter. Time of event listed as the time of the video which also fits well with radar data.
Corrects time of previous hail report from Coweta. Delayed report. Video of hail with a max size of a quarter. Time of event listed as the time of the video which also fits well with radar data.
Mostly pea to marble sized hail with some quarter size. Hail lasted for approximately 30 minutes covering ground. Extensive crop damage from wind driven hail.
Report from mPING: Quarter (1.00 in.). Time adjusted from original report through radar.
Trees uprooted_ large_ 8 to 10 inch diameter branches broken. CR 546 impassable with fallen trees and limbs. Estimated 70 to 80 mph winds reported at local nursery. Extensive crop damage due to wind
Large trees down. Report relayed via emergency management. Time is radar estimated.
Photos of tree and building damage in Marble relayed by broadcast media. Time estimated by radar.
